subject: Predict four published forced-oscillation coefficients per complete record from the prescribed two-frequency orbit and towing speed. Compare the candidate distance between displacement/velocity/acceleration harmonic coefficient vectors against a periodic scalar-coordinate kernel, a displacement-only kernel, train-calibrated ARD GP and boosted trees. The 69 raw traces have no matched recipe and supply no independent measurement validation. The free-response transfer is unqualified.

Keep all fitting rows and all fixed groups. 81:920 are all distinct complete recipes. features.orbit: For order n=0,1,2 form (A1non*(2pi*f1non)^n, A2non*(2pi*f2non)^n*cos(theta), A2non*(2pi*f2non)^n*sin(theta)). These are fixed-quadrature amplitudes on a nominal synchronized orbit; use actual positive reported frequencies for amplitude factors. Weight each triple by one pooled centered training RMS per triple (not separate sine and cosine scaling). Append standardized log f1non and log Speed. Code uses dimensionless frequencies as named in the author plotting code, no calibrated acceleration/force reconstruction.
features.displacement_only: Same map with order0 only, plus log frequency and log speed.
features.periodic: Standardize A1non, log f1non, A2non, log Speed. Append (cos theta,sin theta) with one pooled centered RMS. Include scalar linear-angle model with the first four and standardized theta as a baseline.

models: Candidate/3 baseline features fitted by same Matérn-3/2 kernel ridge. Train-only median positive distance times bandwidth scales [.35,.7,1.4,2.8], ridge alpha [1e-4,.003,.05,.3], arm-wise fixed blocked tuning. ARD reference: periodic baseline coordinates, independent Matérn-3/2 length per coordinate; maximum marginal likelihood on standardized four targets using shared covariance, fitted train only by L-BFGS-B, init all lengths1 noise .03, length [.1,10], noise[1e-4,1]; optimizing noise coefficient as additive variance, deterministic, maxiter80. Boosting: each channel independent HistGradientBoostingRegressor, 250 iterations, learning_rate .06, leaf_nodes=7/15/31, l2=1, early_stopping=False, random_state=747, choose leaf count by same tuning. Include training mean and nearest periodic point. Every fit/prediction must be finite; failure preserved and never quietly remove a comparator.
gate: On all260 development rows and four endpoints, main metric sqrt(mean of all squared channel residuals standardized by final training sigmas); at least5% below every baseline including displacement only, periodic KRR, ARD GP, boosted trees, linear phase, mean and nearest. Each of four individual RMSE must beat or equal the best aggregate competitor on the same channel within5% relative, and rowwise standardized RMS 95th percentile <= same contender. All3 equal-index contiguous subblocks separately reported; no independent-run or uncertainty claim. No reserve labels if any gate fails. Archive every prediction, residual and worst actual study row.

A2non>=.1; no tested zero-inline limit. Results are conditional on the reported designs including adaptive acquisition.
